description: React Native component for adding a new address in a food delivery app, including map interaction, address input, label selection, and mutation to save address.

classes.name: NewAddress
classes.description: React functional component for creating a new address with map and form inputs.

methods.name: regionChange
methods.description: Updates address based on map region change using reverse geocoding.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful address creation mutation, updates context, and navigates accordingly.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during address creation mutation.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles address selection from modal, updates map region and address input.
